dedupe_keys.name: m100 exadata anomaly and thermal prediction examples

description: The ExaData contributors publish Python notebooks for anomaly detection and thermal-hazard prediction using Marconi100 supercomputer telemetry. The repository includes Docker demonstrations and a query client that loads selected metrics or plugins from Parquet into Pandas DataFrames. Users can filter by node, timestamp and month. The thermal notebook documents missing-data processing, annotation, train-test splitting, standardization and support-vector-machine modelling. A root LICENCE file applies CC BY-SA 2.0 to the work, allowing free reuse under those terms. The examples draw on the M100 campaign listed from March 2020 to September 2022, while geographical coverage and measurement intervals follow the CINECA input data, not an independent model grid or time step. They can calibrate detection components and thermal-risk scenarios in data-centre digital twins, directly complementing data-cineca-marconi-examon-telemetry. A caveat is that the repository presents demonstrations, not a verified operational alarm service. Timestamp filtering still has documented limitations for job records. No notebook or container was run, and no telemetry files were downloaded.
